verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single mention that flow actions can include "running code". That is a first-party code step that could transform data, but nothing documents mapping outputs from one step into the inputs of the next. missing for 10: documented data mapping or referencing of previous step outputs, an expression or formula syntax for ops users, built-in transform functions, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can map and transform data between steps with expressions, functions, or formulas

citations.quote: Actions come after the trigger and control what occurs when the flow is activated, like running code or communicating with other services.
